description: 防災マップ(平成28年3月時点) [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 裾野市. 平成28年3月作成の裾野市防災マップデータです。 ※防災マップデータのうち、「土砂災害警戒区域・特別警戒区域」「急傾斜地崩壊危険区域」「洪水浸水想定区域」「緊急輸送路（県）」は静岡県オープンデータのため、掲載していません。. Coverage: 裾野市. The portal files it under the publisher 裾野市. It offers 13 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2024-10-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
